hints.title: Triangle Detection in Graphs
hints.text: A path of length three returning to the start room forms a cycle of length three in the network.

hints.title: Oriented Edge Traversal
hints.text: Enforce an ordering on vertices so that each corridor is inspected from smaller to larger room label.

hints.title: Neighbor Set Intersection
hints.text: Count the number of mutual neighbors shared between both endpoints of each directed edge.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(E * sqrt(E)) intersection of neighbor sets
complexity.notes: Counts cycles of length 3 (triangles) in an undirected graph by directed edge ordering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all V^3 triplets takes O(V^3) which fails for V = 1000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Orienting edges u < v and intersecting neighbor sets counts each triangle exactly once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should orient edges by degree or vertex label to avoid duplicate counting.
